title: Epithelial-mesenchymal transition classification based on machine learning for predicting prognosis and treatment response in clear cell renal cell carcinoma
summary: Methods and Results: ten algorithms generated 101 models; CoxBoost+elastic net signature on TCGA then tested in E-MTAB-1980. Prognostic stratification and modeled drug-response differences are retrospective computational evidence.
